nodes.label: Pure Logic Core
nodes.rationale: Side initiative math stays free of Foundry globals so it remains directly testable under Node.

nodes.label: Defensive Runtime Access
nodes.rationale: Foundry globals are accessed through globalThis-based helpers to remain undefined-safe and stubbable in tests.

nodes.label: Guarded Monkey Patches
nodes.rationale: Combat and Gambits patches are load-bearing and guarded to prevent duplicate installation or incompatible source patching.

nodes.label: Release Automation Policy
nodes.rationale: Release-time tooling rewrites the placeholder manifest version and publishes idempotently, avoiding manual version edits and duplicate-publication failures across mirrored CI systems.

nodes.label: Legendary Action Windows
nodes.rationale: Side turns replace per-creature advancement, so Chris' Premades' normal end-of-turn prompt does not fire; side-aware action windows restore the opportunity without opening excessive prompts for bonus actions or reactions.

nodes.label: Foundry VTT AI Content Policy Compliance
nodes.rationale: The dock artwork is identified as human-created rather than AI-generated, satisfying Foundry VTT's AI content policy.
nodes.norm_label: foundry vtt ai content policy compliance
